notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin attached to Cinderhaze Wretch.
Cinderhaze Wretch does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Activate the nontoken Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
